chapterInfo.content:
15
Mmarima ahosene fi
1Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ: 2#Num 5.2 Monkasa nkyerɛ Israelfoɔ no nse wɔn sɛ: Ɔbarima biara sɛ ne ho sene gu a, n’ahosene no nti ne ho nte. 3Na deɛ ɛgu ne ho fi n’ahosene no mu nie: Sɛ n’ahosene firi ne honam anaasɛ n’ahosene ma ne honam ano si a, ɛyɛ ne ho figuo. 4Mpa biara a deɛ ne ho sene no bɛda so no ho nte, na adeɛ biara a ɔbɛtena soɔ no ho nte. 5Na deɛ ɔka ne mpa no nsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ; 6na deɛ ɔtena adeɛ a deɛ ne ho sene no tenaa soɔ no, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. 7Na deɛ ɔka deɛ ne ho sene no honam no, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ; 8na sɛ deɛ ne ho sene no to ntasuo gu deɛ ne ho teɛ so a, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. 9Na aboa so adwa biara a ɔhosenefoɔ no bɛtena soɔ no ho nte; na obiara a ɔka biribiara a ɛwɔ ɔhosenefoɔ no ase no ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. 10Na deɛ ɔsoa saa adeɛ no nsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. 11Na obiara a ɔhosenefoɔ no amfa nsuo anhohoro ne nsa na ɔbɛka no no, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. 12#Lew 11.33 Na kukuo a ɔhosenefoɔ no bɛka no, wɔmmɔ, na dua adeɛ biara deɛ, wɔmfa nsuo nhohoro ho.
13Na sɛ ɔhosenefoɔ no ho te firi n’ahosene no mu a, ɔnkan nnanson ngu n’ahofire so, na ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ, na ɔmfa mmasuo nnware ne honam, na ne ho ate. 14#Lew 5.7 Na da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, ɔmfa anyankuku mmienu anaa mmorɔnoma mma mmienu mmra AWURADE anim, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na ɔmfa mma ɔsɔfoɔ no. 15Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa baako nyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na baako no nso ɔmfa nyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no AWURADE anim mfiri n’ahosene no mu.
16 # Lew 22.4 Na sɛ ɔbarima bi ahoba firi ne mu a, ɔmfa nsuo nnware ne honam nyinaa, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. 17Na ntoma biara anaa nwoma biara a ahoba bɛgu mu no, wɔmfa nsuo nsi, na ɛho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. 18Na sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa da na ahoba gu no a, wɔmfa nsuo nnware na wɔn ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.
Mmaa ahosene fi
19 # Lew 18.19 Na ɔbaa sɛ ne ho sene na mogya firi ne honam mu gu a, ɔntena ne nsabuo no mu nnanson, na obiara a ɔka no no ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. 20Na adeɛ biara a ɔda soɔ ne nsabuo mu no ho nte, na adeɛ a ɔtena soɔ no ho nte. 21Na obiara a ɔka ne mpa no, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ; 22na obiara a ɔka adeɛ biara a watena soɔ no, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ; 23na sɛ biribi wɔ mpa no so anaasɛ adeɛ a watena soɔ no so a, obi ka a, ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. 24Na sɛ ɔbarima ne no da na ne nsabuo adeɛ no bi ka ne ho a, ne ho nte nnanson, na ne mpa a ɔda soɔ no nyinaa ho nte.
25Na ɔbaa sɛ ne ho sene mogya gu nna pii, na ɛnyɛ ne nsabuo berɛ, anaasɛ ne ho sene tra ne nsabuo a, ɛnneɛ n’ahosene a ɛho nteɛ nna no nyinaa ne ho nte te sɛ ne nsabuo nna mu. 26Ne mpa a ɔda soɔ biara n’ahosene nna nyinaa mu no nyɛ no sɛ ne nsabuo mpa, na adeɛ biara a ɔtena soɔ no ho nte sɛ ne nsabuo mu deɛ no. 27Na obiara a ɔka nnoɔma yi no ho nte, na ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.
28Na sɛ ne ho te firi n’ahosene no mu a, ɔnkan nnanson mfa, na ɛno akyiri no ne ho ate. 29#Lew 15.14 Na da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, ɔmfa anyankuku mmienu anaa mmorɔnoma mma mmienu mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano. 30Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa baako mmɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na baako no ɔmfa mmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no, AWURADE anim, mfiri n’ahosene a ɛho nteɛ no mu.
31Na momma Israelfoɔ no nyi wɔn ho mfiri wɔn fi mu, na wɔanwuwu wɔn fi mu sɛ wɔrekɔgu me tenabea a ɛwɔ wɔn mu no ho fi.
32Yei ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma deɛ ne ho sene ne deɛ ne ho nsuo firi ne mu gu ne ho fi, 33ne ɔbaa a ne ho nyɛ no den ne nsabuo mu, ne deɛ ne ho sene, ɔbarima oo, ɔbaa oo, ne ɔbarima a ɔne ɔbaa a ne ho nteɛ bɛda.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ: Monkasa nkyerɛ Israelfoɔ no nse wɔn sɛ: Ɔbarima biara sɛ ne ho sene gu a, n’ahosene no nti ne ho nte. Na deɛ ɛgu ne ho fi n’ahosene no mu nie: Sɛ n’ahosene firi ne honam anaasɛ n’ahosene ma ne honam ano si a, ɛyɛ ne ho figuo. Mpa biara a deɛ ne ho sene no bɛda so no ho nte, na adeɛ biara a ɔbɛtena soɔ no ho nte. Na deɛ ɔka ne mpa no nsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ; na deɛ ɔtena adeɛ a deɛ ne ho sene no tenaa soɔ no, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. Na deɛ ɔka deɛ ne ho sene no honam no, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ; na sɛ deɛ ne ho sene no to ntasuo gu deɛ ne ho teɛ so a, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. Na aboa so adwa biara a ɔhosenefoɔ no bɛtena soɔ no ho nte; na obiara a ɔka biribiara a ɛwɔ ɔhosenefoɔ no ase no ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. Na deɛ ɔsoa saa adeɛ no nsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. Na obiara a ɔhosenefoɔ no amfa nsuo anhohoro ne nsa na ɔbɛka no no, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. Na kukuo a ɔhosenefoɔ no bɛka no, wɔmmɔ, na dua adeɛ biara deɛ, wɔmfa nsuo nhohoro ho.
Na sɛ ɔhosenefoɔ no ho te firi n’ahosene no mu a, ɔnkan nnanson ngu n’ahofire so, na ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ, na ɔmfa mmasuo nnware ne honam, na ne ho ate. Na da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, ɔmfa anyankuku mmienu anaa mmorɔnoma mma mmienu mmra AWURADE anim, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na ɔmfa mma ɔsɔfoɔ no. Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa baako nyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na baako no nso ɔmfa nyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no AWURADE anim mfiri n’ahosene no mu.
Na sɛ ɔbarima bi ahoba firi ne mu a, ɔmfa nsuo nnware ne honam nyinaa, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. Na ntoma biara anaa nwoma biara a ahoba bɛgu mu no, wɔmfa nsuo nsi, na ɛho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. Na sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa da na ahoba gu no a, wɔmfa nsuo nnware na wɔn ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

Na ɔbaa sɛ ne ho sene na mogya firi ne honam mu gu a, ɔntena ne nsabuo no mu nnanson, na obiara a ɔka no no ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. Na adeɛ biara a ɔda soɔ ne nsabuo mu no ho nte, na adeɛ a ɔtena soɔ no ho nte. Na obiara a ɔka ne mpa no, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ; na obiara a ɔka adeɛ biara a watena soɔ no, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ; na sɛ biribi wɔ mpa no so anaasɛ adeɛ a watena soɔ no so a, obi ka a, ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. Na sɛ ɔbarima ne no da na ne nsabuo adeɛ no bi ka ne ho a, ne ho nte nnanson, na ne mpa a ɔda soɔ no nyinaa ho nte.
Na ɔbaa sɛ ne ho sene mogya gu nna pii, na ɛnyɛ ne nsabuo berɛ, anaasɛ ne ho sene tra ne nsabuo a, ɛnneɛ n’ahosene a ɛho nteɛ nna no nyinaa ne ho nte te sɛ ne nsabuo nna mu. Ne mpa a ɔda soɔ biara n’ahosene nna nyinaa mu no nyɛ no sɛ ne nsabuo mpa, na adeɛ biara a ɔtena soɔ no ho nte sɛ ne nsabuo mu deɛ no. Na obiara a ɔka nnoɔma yi no ho nte, na ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.
Na sɛ ne ho te firi n’ahosene no mu a, ɔnkan nnanson mfa, na ɛno akyiri no ne ho ate. Na da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, ɔmfa anyankuku mmienu anaa mmorɔnoma mma mmienu mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano. Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa baako mmɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na baako no ɔmfa mmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no, AWURADE anim, mfiri n’ahosene a ɛho nteɛ no mu.
Na momma Israelfoɔ no nyi wɔn ho mfiri wɔn fi mu, na wɔanwuwu wɔn fi mu sɛ wɔrekɔgu me tenabea a ɛwɔ wɔn mu no ho fi.
Yei ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma deɛ ne ho sene ne deɛ ne ho nsuo firi ne mu gu ne ho fi, ne ɔbaa a ne ho nyɛ no den ne nsabuo mu, ne deɛ ne ho sene, ɔbarima oo, ɔbaa oo, ne ɔbarima a ɔne ɔbaa a ne ho nteɛ bɛda.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
